findings.title: Include recoveries that resume in Pending
findings.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include recoveries that resume in Pending**

When a rule with a nonzero `for` duration enters `Error` and its next successful evaluation still satisfies the condition, Grafana can recover into `Pending` rather than `Normal` or `Alerting`. This classifier ignores that transition, and `errorStateHistoryUrl` also requests only `previous=Error&current=Normal`, so Recent alerts retains the failure but omits the corresponding monitoring recovery that Slack emits; query and classify `Error` transitions into `Pending` as recoveries too.

findings.title: Error recovery leaves breach active
findings.body:
### Error recovery leaves breach active **High Severity** `pairStateTransitions` keeps alert and error cycles on separate keys, so `error-recovered` only closes the error lane. After `Alerting` → `Error` → `Normal`, the earlier `raised` stays open and Recent alerts still shows an active peg breach even though Grafana is `Normal` and the new recovery row says monitoring resumed. Peg rules use `exec_err_state = "Error"`, so this path is reachable whenever evaluation fails during a real alert and then recovers clear.
Additional Locations (1) - [`ui-dashboard/src/app/api/peg-monitoring/alerts/peg-alert-events.ts#L104-L115`](https://github.com/mento-protocol/monitoring-monorepo/blob/5e9845490149e2ff1f3f20c0d0b6d24cd5877bdc/ui-dashboard/src/app/api/peg-monitoring/alerts/peg-alert-events.ts#L104-L115)

findings.title: Pending recovery orphans error cycle
findings.body:
### Pending recovery orphans error cycle **Medium Severity** Error cycles only close on `Error` → `Alerting` or `Error` → `Normal`. Several Peg rules use a non-zero `for` duration, and Grafana can recover through `Error` → `Pending` → `Alerting`. Pending transitions are intentionally not queried, so the error opening never pairs and Recent alerts can keep a stuck “monitoring failed” row after evaluation has already resumed.
Additional Locations (1) - [`ui-dashboard/src/app/api/peg-monitoring/alerts/peg-alert-events.ts#L317-L352`](https://github.com/mento-protocol/monitoring-monorepo/blob/5e9845490149e2ff1f3f20c0d0b6d24cd5877bdc/ui-dashboard/src/app/api/peg-monitoring/alerts/peg-alert-events.ts#L317-L352)

findings.title: Label source-less evaluation failures by rule
findings.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Label source-less evaluation failures by rule**

When an asset-wide or policy rule enters `Error`, `labels.source` is empty—as it is for Structural Saturation, Indexed Pool, Heartbeat, and Policy Rollover rules—so this calls `pegAlertSourceName("")`, which returns `Price source`. Both failure and recovery rows then claim Grafana evaluated a nonexistent “Price source Peg rule,” obscuring which monitor failed; branch on an empty source and derive the label from the rule and asset instead.
